name: my-bricks-builder
description: Suggests models to build from the bricks you own (LEGO or DUPLO) and draws step-by-step instructions.

interface.longDescription:
Tell My Bricks Builder which bricks you have (a photo of the pile, a parts list or set numbers) and it suggests models you can build right now from exactly those parts, then draws step-by-step instructions in the style of a printed booklet, with a short build video on request. Every model is checked: nothing floats, nothing overlaps, and every part is one you own. Ideas that are almost buildable come with the exact list of missing parts. DUPLO works too: a house, a tower and a pyramid at real DUPLO scale. You can also take apart a saved model step by step and rebuild something new from its parts.

For families and kids with a box of mixed bricks and no instructions. Limits: part recognition from photos can make mistakes (you can correct the list); the app only draws common bricks, plates, slopes and a few special parts; daily limits apply (300 tool calls, 10 videos, 40 photos per account). Not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by the LEGO Group.
defaultPrompt: What can I build from my bricks? Here is a photo of my pile.
I have sets 31058 and 10696, what can I build from them?
I have DUPLO bricks: 20 red 2x4 and 10 blue 2x2. What can my toddler build?

positive.description: Ideas from a typed parts list
positive.prompt: My parts are 10 red 2x4 bricks (3001), 8 white 2x2 bricks (3003), 6 blue 2x2 slopes (3039) and 2 green 4x6 plates (3032). What can I build?
positive.expected_behavior: The parts are saved to the account and a card shows pictures of models buildable from exactly these parts, plus ideas that are close with the exact missing parts.

positive.description: Build the chosen idea with step pictures
positive.prompt: Build the house and show me the steps.
positive.expected_behavior: A card with the house drawn from the user's parts, the parts list and step-by-step pictures. Only parts the user owns are used.

positive.prompt: I own LEGO sets 31058 and 10696. What can I build from them?
positive.expected_behavior: The parts of both sets are added and a card with buildable ideas is shown.

positive.prompt: Clear my parts. I have DUPLO: 20 red 3011, 10 blue 3437, 6 red 4199, 1 bright green 4672 and 10 blue 6474. What can my toddler build?
positive.expected_behavior: Only DUPLO ideas are offered (DUPLO house, tower, pyramid), drawn at DUPLO scale. No LEGO ideas are mixed in.

positive.description: Take apart a saved model and rebuild
positive.prompt: Show me how to take apart the built-in cat model, then what else I can build from its parts.
positive.expected_behavior: A card with the cat's exact parts list, an exploded view and reverse steps, then ideas built from the cat's parts.

negative.description: Buying sets or prices are out of scope
negative.prompt: Buy me the LEGO Millennium Falcon set and tell me the cheapest price.

negative.description: Official instructions for a set are not provided
negative.prompt: Give me the official building instructions PDF for set 75192.
Write my history homework essay about the French Revolution.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell products or process payments. For ideas that are close, it lists the missing part numbers (and a BrickLink wanted list) for the user's information only.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: ideas from your own bricks (photo, parts list or set numbers), checked models, booklet-style steps and build videos, take-apart and rebuild, DUPLO support.
